North: F12 single / F7 double @190ms. Lone->F12; double pair->F7 only, base F12 suppressed. DELTA: JSM fires base on first press of double pair; Steam suppresses it.

TL->Shift,TR->E,TL+TR->Q. Steam chord: Shift held+Q (member binding leaks), E suppressed. No sticky-state bug on Steam. DELTA both ways: Steam leaks member binding; JSM SIMPRESS suppresses both.
Lone TL after chord -> Shift correctly on Steam (no sticky state). Confirms JSM degraded is JSM-specific.
